name: replaced
note: css-display-3 §2: replaced elements cannot be display:contents — Blink computes 'none' for them (probed), so the img generates no box (all-zero rect despite width/height attributes) and the following sibling lays out at the top with no gap. The computed display value ('none', not 'contents') is pinned on the computed-style layer.
